messages:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock onboarding window + fallback drain scenarios for Dedicated GA next week. Customers are asking for predictable burst behavior; ops wants a safe automatic drain. Proposal below, pls react with :thumbsup: or concerns.

Carlos (Eng Infra): high level ok. need to be explicit about preempt vs throttle. Preempting has customer-facing latency / errors risk.

Maya (PM): thinking 3 phased fallback: 1) soft throttle (rate limit per-tenant), 2) spillover to reserved elastic buffer, 3) preempt lower-priority sessions. Defaults: 5m warm window, 10% burst headroom, 2s latency SLO target.

Priya (SRE): +1 on phases. Concern: soft throttle alone doesn't protect control plane during global surge. We should add a circuit-breaker that trips after sustained 95th p95 token CPU > 85% for 2m.

Ben (Customer Success): customers will accept throttles if communicated and plumbed into billing/credits. They explicitly reject silent preemption on critical routes. We should add an opt-in flag for preemptible workloads.

Jamie (Eng Runtime): runtime notes: KV cache & prefix cache warm-ups reduce cold-tail cost. We can expose a `prewarm` hint in the API so Dedicated clients can request warm state during onboarding window. Also recommend quantized model variants as fallback.

Carlos (Eng Infra): implementation sketch:
```
reserve_config {
  warm_window: 300s
  burst_headroom_pct: 10
  soft_throttle: { rate_limit_per_minute: 600 }
  circuit_breaker: { cpu_p95_pct: 85, duration_s: 120 }
}
```
We need a safe default and a per-tenant override.

Priya (SRE): metrics to emit for ops: tenant_active_sessions, tenant_throttle_rate, spillover_usage, preempt_count, reserve_headroom_pct. Alerts: spillover_usage > 70% for 5m, preempt_count > 0 (info), circuit_breaker trips (page).

Ben (Customer Success): For onboarding: require a 2-week notice for any change that would allow preemption, include sample fallback behavior in onboarding docs, and add a customer-facing webhook for throttle/preempt events.

Maya (PM): Launch criteria checklist (candidate):
- Canary run with 5 pilot customers (>=48h)
- Telemetry + dashboards for metrics Priya listed
- Onboarding docs + webhook implemented
- Opt-in flag for preemptible routes
- QA integration tests for soft_throttle + spillover + preempt

Carlos (Eng Infra): timeline: can get a minimal implementation for canary in 2 sprints if we scope to soft_throttle + reserve_spillover only. Preemptible eviction needs policy work with billing & CS.

Jamie (Eng Runtime): Can provide `prewarm` API and telemetry in sprint 1. Quantized fallback models need model-team signoff — recommend do as v2.

Priya (SRE): ops runbook: on circuit-breaker trip -> auto-throttle tenants above baseline, page on repeated trips, fallback to regional spillover. I'll draft runbook.

Ben (Customer Success): I'll coordinate pilot customers and draft the onboarding notice + webhook schema.

Maya (PM): Action items: Carlos -> prod config + canary infra; Jamie -> prewarm API + telemetry; Priya -> runbook + alerts; Ben -> pilot comms + docs; Maya -> consolidate launch checklist and stakeholder sign-off.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: dedicated-canary/fallback-v1 -> staging at 2024-04-09T18:00Z

Maya (PM): Thanks all — please add any missing items. If no major objections by EOD tomorrow we'll lock scope to soft_throttle + reserve_spillover for GA and defer preemptible eviction to post-GA opt-in feature. :rocket:
